planScopeOverlapping: Plan scope keeps Tasks that overlap it, not only those within it
startHidesCheckedWaits: Start hides waits that have checks (shows their check task instead)
searchIncludesArchived: Include archived nodes in search (Ctrl+O, and nodes in Ctrl+F and the Filter menu)
listShowOverdueBorder: Show the overdue border on rows
tearOffLastTab: This is the window's only tab — tearing it off would leave the window empty. Open another tab first, or move this one into a window that is already open.

systemBarsHelp: How the app sits against the Android status and gesture bars. Standard: visible, opaque, the app below them. Edge-to-edge: visible but transparent, the app drawn under them with its controls kept clear. Immersive: hidden, swipe from the screen edge to show them briefly. Android only.
systemBarsFullscreenHelp: The same choice while the app is in fullscreen; leaving fullscreen returns to the setting above. Android only.
